products.name: Aluminum parts and articles
products.note: Section 232 aluminum derivative. Verify that the HTS line is in scope.

context: IEEPA tariffs were struck down by the Supreme Court on Feb 20, 2026. Refunds run through CBP's CAPE program.
The temporary Section 122 surcharge expired on Jul 24, 2026.
Section 301 forced-labor duties of 10% or 12.5% took effect on Jul 24, 2026 for 60 economies.
The US-China trade truce, covering some 301 exclusions and port fees, was extended to Jan 10, 2027.
De minimis duty-free entry has been suspended since Aug 29, 2025.
